repos.description: mall项目是一套电商系统，包括前台商城系统及后台管理系统，基于Spring Boot+MyBatis实现，采用Docker容器化部署。 前台商城系统包含首页门户、商品推荐、商品搜索、商品展示、购物车、订单流程、会员中心、客户服务、帮助中心等模块。 后台管理系统包含商品管理、订单管理、会员管理、促销管理、运营管理、内容管理、统计报表、财务管理、权限管理、设置等模块。
repos.summary_zh: mall 是一个完整的电商系统，包含基于 Spring Boot + MyBatis 的前台商城和后台管理系统，支持 Docker 容器化部署。前台涵盖商品展示、搜索、购物车、订单流程等核心电商功能；后台提供商品、订单、会员、促销等全链路管理。集成 Elasticsearch、Redis、RabbitMQ 等主流中间件，适合企业级电商项目开发与学习。
repos.summary_en: Mall is a full-featured e-commerce system with front-end portal and back-end management, built on Spring Boot + MyBatis and deployed via Docker. It includes product display, search, cart, checkout, and user management on the frontend, and supports comprehensive backend operations like inventory, orders, promotions, and analytics. Integrated with Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, and other modern technologies, it serves as a robust platform for enterprise-level e-commerce development and learning.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: all of the workflows of n8n i could find (also from the site itself)
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集了 n8n 自动化工作流的完整集合，包含 4343+ 个工作流和 365+ 种集成，覆盖网页抓取、AI 智能体、数据同步等场景。核心亮点是集成 AI-BOM 工具，可扫描工作流中的 AI 安全风险，如硬编码密钥、未授权 AI 代理和危险工具组合，提供合规性报告，助力满足 EU AI Act 要求。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates 4,343+ n8n automation workflows with 365+ integrations, covering web scraping, AI agents, and data synchronization. Its standout feature is the integration of AI-BOM, the first tool to scan n8n workflows for AI security risks—detecting hardcoded keys, unauthenticated agents, and dangerous tool combinations—while generating compliance-ready reports aligned with EU AI Act deadlines.

repos.description: open-source agentic AI data assistant for the next generation of AI + Data products.
repos.summary_zh: DB-GPT 是一个开源的 AI 原生数据应用开发框架，集成 AWEL（智能体工作流表达式语言）和多智能体协作机制，支持多模型管理与 Text2SQL 优化，提供 RAG 增强生成能力，旨在降低企业级数据应用开发门槛，实现低代码构建定制化数据产品。
repos.summary_en: DB-GPT is an open-source AI-native data application development framework featuring AWEL (Agentic Workflow Expression Language) and multi-agent collaboration. It supports multi-model management, Text2SQL optimization, and RAG-enhanced generation, enabling low-code development of enterprise-grade data applications.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP 是一款功能强大的 IP 工具箱，支持多维度网络检测与隐私分析。核心功能包括：实时 IP 信息查询、WebRTC 连接检测、DNS 泄漏测试、全球节点延迟与 MTR 测试、网站可用性检查、代理规则验证及网络安全清单（258项）。支持 PWA 桌面应用、暗黑模式、键盘快捷键和多语言界面，适用于网络诊断、隐私保护和跨境访问测试。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is a comprehensive IP toolbox offering multi-dimensional network diagnostics and privacy analysis. Key features include real-time IP information lookup, WebRTC connection detection, DNS leak testing, global latency/MTR tests, website availability checks, proxy rule validation, and a 258-item cybersecurity checklist. It supports PWA desktop apps, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts, and multi-language interfaces for network troubleshooting, privacy protection, and cross-border access testing.

repos.description: A very powerful and friendly  nginx base on lua-nginx-module( openresty ) which provide WAF, Control Panel, and Dashboards.
repos.summary_zh: VeryNginx 是基于 OpenResty 的强大 Nginx 增强工具，集成 WAF、访问统计、控制面板和仪表盘，支持自定义匹配器与动作实现灵活规则引擎，提供友好的 Web 界面管理复杂流量策略。
repos.summary_en: VeryNginx is a powerful and user-friendly Nginx extension based on OpenResty, featuring built-in WAF, real-time access statistics, control panel, and dashboards. It enables advanced traffic management through customizable matchers and actions, offering a web interface for complex rule-based request processing and security enforcement.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等场景，并解析《刑法》《网络安全法》等法律条文，为从业者提供合规指引，避免触碰数据安全与个人信息保护的法律红线。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles Chinese web crawler violation cases involving illegal data collection, commercial infringement, and unauthorized access. It analyzes relevant laws including the Criminal Law and Cybersecurity Law to guide practitioners in avoiding legal risks related to data compliance and personal information protection.

repos.description: 一个基于✨HOOK机制的微信机器人，支持🌱安全新闻定时推送【FreeBuf，先知，安全客，奇安信攻防社区】，👯Kfc文案，⚡漏洞查询，⚡手机号归属地查询，⚡知识库查询，🎉星座查询，⚡天气查询，🌱摸鱼日历，⚡微步威胁情报查询， 🐛视频，⚡图片，👯帮助菜单。📫 支持积分功能，⚡支持自动拉人，，🌱自动群发，👯Ai回复（国内主流AI模型，扣子，FastGpt，Dify全面支持！），⚡视频号解析，😄自定义程度丰富，小白也可轻松上手！
repos.summary_zh: NGCBot 是一款基于 HOOK 机制的微信机器人，集成安全资讯推送、AI 智能回复、漏洞查询、天气日历等丰富功能，支持主流 AI 平台，具备自动拉群、群发、视频解析等自动化能力，自定义程度高，适合安全从业者与社群运营。
repos.summary_en: NGCBot is a HOOK-based WeChat robot supporting security news push, AI replies, vulnerability queries, weather, calendar, and more. It integrates with major AI platforms, offers automation features like auto-invite and group messaging, and is highly customizable for non-technical users.

repos.description: Free anti fingerprint browser, 指纹浏览器, 隐私浏览器, 防识别浏览器, 反识别浏览器, 防关联浏览器, 免费的web3空投专用指纹浏览器 https://virtualbrowser.cc/?src=github
repos.summary_zh: VirtualBrowser 是一款基于 Chromium 的免费反指纹浏览器，支持多环境隔离与指纹定制，可修改操作系统、代理、语言、时区等数十项指纹特征，适用于 Web3 空投防关联场景。提供自动化接口，支持 Playwright 集成，具备跨平台扩展潜力。
repos.summary_en: VirtualBrowser is a free anti-fingerprint browser based on Chromium, enabling multi-environment isolation and customizable fingerprinting. It allows modification of OS, proxy, language, timezone, and over 15+ fingerprint attributes for Web3 airdrop protection. Supports automation via Playwright and offers cross-platform expansion plans.

repos.description: 企业级 AI 编程助手，专为 研发协作 和 研发管理 场景而设计。
repos.summary_zh: MonkeyCode 是一款企业级 AI 编程助手，专为研发协作与管理场景设计，支持私有化部署与本地大模型接入，提供 IDE 对话式编程、代码补全、安全扫描及 Git 平台机器人能力，内置企业级管理面板用于审计管控与资源统一调度，兼顾效率与代码安全。
repos.summary_en: MonkeyCode is an enterprise-grade AI programming assistant designed for R&D collaboration and management. It supports private deployment, local LLM integration, and offline usage, offering IDE-based coding, intelligent completions, security scanning, Git platform bots, and a management panel for auditing, compliance, and centralized model usage control.

repos.description: A search-first, profile-aware reverse-engineering workspace for AI agents — 735 tools across 36 domains in one MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: jshookmcp 是一个基于 MCP 协议的智能 JavaScript 分析工具平台，集成浏览器自动化、Chrome DevTools 调试、网络监控、智能代码钩子、LLM 驱动的反混淆与 AST 分析等功能。采用搜索优先的上下文优化策略，支持渐进式能力扩展与热加载插件，适用于逆向工程与安全分析场景。
repos.summary_en: jshookmcp is an AI-powered MCP server for intelligent JavaScript analysis, combining browser automation, CDP debugging, network interception, LLM-driven deobfuscation, and AST-level comprehension. It features search-first context efficiency, progressive capability tiers, hot-reload extensibility, and zero-wiring plugin discovery, ideal for reverse engineering and security analysis.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI代理OpenClaw设计，采用‘代理式零信任架构’范式，从传统静态防御转向动态防护。通过三层防御矩阵（事前行为黑名单、事中权限限制、事后夜间审计）有效应对提示注入、供应链投毒等AI特有风险，支持强推理模型自动部署，显著降低用户配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is tailored for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional static defense to 'Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture'. It implements a battle-tested 3-Tier Defense Matrix—pre-action blacklists, in-action permission controls, and post-action nightly audits—to mitigate LLM-specific threats like prompt injection and supply chain poisoning. Designed for seamless integration with strong reasoning models to minimize manual security setup.

repos.description: Authenticator on Windows for Battle.net / Steam / Guild Wars 2 / Glyph / Runescape / SWTOR / Bitcoin and digital currency exchanges
repos.summary_zh: WinAuth 是一款开源的 Windows 多平台双因子认证工具，支持 RFC 6238 时间型（TOTP）和 HOTP 计数器型验证码，兼容 Battle.net、Steam、Guild Wars 2、SWTOR 及主流数字货币交易所。具备密码保护、机器绑定、YubiKey 支持、热键操作、便携模式及跨设备导入导出功能，适用于安全与便捷的双重认证管理。
repos.summary_en: WinAuth is an open-source, portable authenticator for Windows that supports RFC 6238 (TOTP) and HOTP-based 2FA codes. It integrates authenticators for Battle.net, Steam, Guild Wars 2, SWTOR, and major cryptocurrency exchanges like Coinbase and Bitstamp. Features include password protection, machine binding, YubiKey support, hotkey controls, portable mode, and import/export via UriKeyFormat, enabling secure and unified two-factor authentication management.

repos.summary_zh: Django Ratelimit 是一个基于缓存的 Django 速率限制中间件，通过装饰器为视图提供灵活的限流功能，支持基于 IP 地址或请求参数（GET/POST）进行访问控制，适用于防止滥用和保障 API 安全。
repos.summary_en: Django Ratelimit is a cache-based rate-limiting library for Django that uses decorators to limit view access, configurable by IP address or request parameters (GET/POST), ideal for preventing abuse and securing APIs.

repos.description: Claude Code 中文开发套件 - 为中国开发者定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境。一键安装完整中文化体验，集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描，支持免翻墙访问。让 AI 编程更简单。
repos.summary_zh: Claude Code 中文开发套件是为中国开发者量身定制的零门槛 AI 编程环境，提供一键安装的全中文化体验。集成 MCP 服务器、智能上下文管理、安全扫描等核心功能，支持免翻墙访问。最新版本融合 Anthropic 黑客松冠军配置，包含 9 个专用智能体、7+ 技能模块、10 个快捷指令和完整规则体系，实现从需求分析到代码审查的全流程 AI 驱动开发。
repos.summary_en: Claude Code Chinese Development Kit is a zero-threshold AI programming environment tailored for Chinese developers, offering one-click installation with full Chinese localization. It integrates MCP servers, intelligent context management, security scanning, and supports direct access without VPN. The latest version incorporates the Anthropic Hackathon-winning configuration, featuring 9 specialized agents, 7+ skill modules, 10 slash commands, and a complete rule system for end-to-end AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: Django Brake - a versatile ratelimiting app for Django.
repos.summary_zh: Django Brake 是一个为 Django 框架设计的速率限制应用，支持基于 IP 地址或请求字段（GET/POST）的灵活限流策略。它提供装饰器接口，可阻止超限请求或标记请求状态，适用于登录防护、API 保护等场景，兼容 Django 1.3+ 并支持多时间阈值与路径级限流。
repos.summary_en: Django Brake is a versatile rate-limiting app for Django that uses decorators to limit views based on IP or request fields (GET/POST). It supports blocking or annotating exceeded requests, with configurable time thresholds and path-based buckets. Designed as a maintained fork of Django Ratelimit, it enhances flexibility for login protection and API security.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

repos.description: Integrate awesome Bleach library into Django
repos.summary_zh: django-bleach 是一个 Django 应用，用于将 Bleach 库集成到项目中，实现对用户提交的 HTML 内容进行安全过滤和净化。它提供模型字段、表单字段和模板过滤器三种使用方式，支持自定义允许的标签、属性和样式，防止 XSS 攻击，适用于需要富文本输入的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-bleach is a Django app that integrates the Bleach library to sanitize user-submitted HTML content. It offers model fields, form fields, and template filters for safe HTML processing, with customizable allowed tags, attributes, and styles to prevent XSS attacks in web applications requiring rich text input.
